headline: Kinjal Shah appointed as Chief Technology Officer replacing Amit Mahajan
why: CTO change at a depository; Kinjal Shah brings ~25 years of experience from Yes Securities, NSE, and others.

people.name: Kinjal Shah
people.background: Masters in Computer Science and BE in Electronics with around 25 years of experience. Previously with Yes Securities for 3 years, and earlier with NSE Ltd., Edelweiss Global Markets Ltd, L&T Ltd., J.P Morgan Chase etc.
